cast.name: Maya
cast.role: the office worker of the running example; never drawn as a person, present through her cards and her reply note

devices.what: Maya's four request cards (client reply, budget report, expenses, deck redesign): the same rough card all lesson, its state changes on the spoken word (urgent tag, tick, placed, later tag)
the impact and effort board: the two questions of b04 become its axis labels, four zones are named as each move is taught
a hand-drawn Monday to Friday strip where big work becomes one solid block instead of scraps
a written reply note tied by an arrow to the budget report card, with a date and a smaller version under it
one whiteboard: a camera pan to the next part of the board and back to the first list at the close

parts.what: Maya's request card on the whiteboard: a rough single-line rectangle about 300 x 84 px sized to its words, the task name in Patrick Hand lead (38 px) ink. One function draws any of the five cards (Client reply, Budget report, Expenses, Deck redesign, New analysis by Friday) as named elements. States, each drawn on its own element so it can arrive on a spoken word: an 'urgent' tag (a small rough box at the card's right end with the word urgent in ink label size, no colour); a tick box at the left (empty rough square, then a pos hand tick); a 'later' tag (muted words in a small rough box); the card may be held across beats and travel once to a new place (m.travel). No pills, no fills, no shadows.

The impact and effort board on the matrix station, in station coordinates: vertical axis from (200, 860) up to (200, 170) with an open hand arrow head, horizontal axis from (200, 860) to (1190, 860) with an open head; the axis labels are where b04 writes 'Impact?' (top of the vertical axis, x 120..420, y 100..170) and 'Effort?' (right end of the horizontal axis, x 1000..1200, y 870..925, above 930); two divider strokes at x 695 and y 515 make four zones, drawn as separate elements; four zone names written in Caveat title size in each zone's top corner (Quick wins top left, Major projects top right, Fill-ins bottom left, Thankless tasks bottom right), each with a short action line under it in Patrick Hand label muted (Do first, Block time, Batch, Decline or park); card slots: top left (250, 260), top right (745, 260), bottom left (250, 610), bottom right (745, 610), and a second top-right slot (745, 380) for the new card. The right column x 1260..1800 is left free for the week strip and notes. One marker line, hand arrows only.

A hand-drawn week strip in the matrix station's right column (x 1270..1790, y 150..330): five rough day cells Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri with the day names in label ink; states: scattered scraps (three small muted rough boxes across different days, labelled 'budget'), then one solid block (a rough rectangle over Tue and Wed with a hachure fill drawn outline first, labelled 'Budget report'), then a second block (over Thu and Fri, labelled 'New analysis'). The scraps are struck through, never erased.

props.title: Four requests. All four say urgent.

design.treatment: Maya's Monday list drawn as four task_card rows in arrival order (deck redesign, expenses, client reply, budget report), each with its urgent tag; ticks run down on 'works down from the top' while a small clock beside the list turns to Friday; the budget report at the bottom keeps its empty tick box, circled in the accent.
design.why_motion: the ticks running down in arrival order while the clock runs out IS the failure being shown
